title: América Latina en la Guerra Fría
goal: Read how Kennedy's Alliance for Progress offered aid conditioned on moderate reform and anti-communist alignment, and why some governments implemented real reforms.
grammar: Con tal de que + subjuntivo: una condición explícita

items: Explain what Cuba became after its revolution transformed its foreign policy.
Explain what recipient governments had to do in exchange for aid.
Explain why some countries implemented real reforms.
Use con tal de que + subjunctive to state an explicit condition.
